recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13925 unless future publisher changes regress value set usage link generation.
issue_request: FHIR-13925 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core terminology issue asking to fix a generated ValueSet/binding-strength usage link that pointed to datatypes.html#ElementDefinition instead of the specific ElementDefinition.binding.strength anchor.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in svn revision 13381, imported as git commit 88d9593bedb4b0a084524ff8b7559f471e2e1c76 with subject "GF#13925 - fix broken links". That commit changed publisher value set usage link generation to use source definition pages and append element path anchors.
additional_context: Current source still declares BindingStrength in source/terminologies/bindings.xml and binds ElementDefinition.binding.strength to it in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml. source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active type and maps it to the elementdefinition page. The current CI build renders the value set usage entry as elementdefinition-definitions.html#ElementDefinition.binding.strength, and the target anchor exists. Community searches found only tracker/commit notifications or unrelated binding-strength discussions.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current generated output already satisfies the requested link target and the historical application was a publisher-generator fix rather than a stale terminology spreadsheet row.
